name: Example homebrew pack
_about: Load this on the Backup & level up tab under Content packs. Every section is optional. Use it for spells, items and subclasses from books you own: write the summaries in your own words. Spell time is action, bonus, reaction, or text like "1 minute". Subclass features are listed by class level.

spells.name: Ember Flick
spells.sum: A spark leaps at one creature. On a failed Dex save it takes 1d6 fire damage.

spells.name: Warding Chime
spells.sum: When you're hit, a chime rings and you gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
spells.up: +1 AC for every two slot levels above 1st.

items.name: Lantern of Calm Waters
items.text: While lit, creatures within 10 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened.

features.name: Tidecaller
features.text: Bonus action: push a creature within 15 ft up to 10 ft. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
